eligibility.evidence: Mechanistic-interpretability study (Sections 4-7): linear probe on token embeddings, nonce-embedding interventions, FutureLens forecasting. The 'token-level wug test' (cites Berko 1958, Sec 5) manipulates embeddings, not a human-style task administered to the model; the only prompted task, explicit sound-judgment yes/no (Sec 7.2, Table 7), is not tied to a cited human paradigm. No human data. A reviewer could count a/an selection plus the wug-test link as E2/E4.

A.title: How Do Language Models Represent and Use Phonological Information for Allomorph Selection?

G.notes: Excluded as neural-only; borderline because the paper adapts the wug-test logic (Berko 1958) and reports next-token article probabilities under embedding interventions in Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-3B, Gemma-3-1b (plus Llama-3.3-70B appendix). Code link at github.com/Koolkumn/allomorph-selection.
